slice.name: Casa Corallina · contemporary Caribbean villa
slice.concept: A low, wide ground-floor living pavilion opens to a deep veranda and pool; a hip-roofed sleeping bar floats above it and a tall stone entry tower marks arrival. Flat site, cross-breezes, deep shade.
hierarchy: Glazed living pavilion + veranda + pool (heart of the house)
Low guest wing and cabana wing as quiet flanks
slice.roofLanguage: Low hip roofs with deep timber eaves over the suite and cabana; crisp flat bronze roof on the tower; roof terrace on the guest wing.
slice.entrance: Pivot door in a stone tower beneath a timber canopy, with a double-height glazed stair hall beside it.
slice.outdoorLiving: Fifteen-metre covered veranda stepping out to a limestone pool terrace; cabana lounge with garden door.
slice.landscape: Palm-lined forecourt, clipped boundary hedges, lawns and planting beds that frame but never touch the building.
